open_questions.description: What happens to the old microphones once the new ones arrive -- whether they are given to someone

notes: The microphone purchase is NOT recorded as a decision, and this is the closest call in the set. me011 says 'what I decided to do, on Morgan's suggestion, was just get two new microphones' (seg-0041) -- past tense, taken outside the meeting and reported into it, exactly like the finance briefings in tiron-TS3003a-c01 and the twenty percent cut in tiron-MTG_32179-c01. Applying the rule consistently matters more than the individual call, because an extractor is graded against the whole set. The old-microphones question gets a non-answer ('they go where old microphones go') and then drifts into what spare kit exists, so it stays open. The case ends with the ICSI digit-reading task (seg-0104 onward), which is recording protocol, not content.
